title: Ekyamagero ky’Obukakafu Obusirise
intro: Osanga emboozi eriko ekifaananyi ekibikkiddwa ey’okuyingira mu nsonga z’obwakatonda. Enfumo y’okugaba mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero n’okwewozaako okutaliimu kwogera okuwulikika mu biseera. Osobola okuzuula ani eyayolekagana n’okugezesebwa kuno okw’ekitalo?
clues: Nafuna obubaka obw’obwakatonda obwandeka nga nneewuunya
Abantu bange baabuusabuusa obulongoofu bwange bwe nakomawo n’omwana
Nalagirwa okusiiba okuva mu kwogera okumala ekiseera
Ensulo y’amazzi n’ennaku z’ennaku zaanyimirizaawo mu kiseera ky’okugezesebwa kwange
Mukama wange yakankanya omuti ogw’ekyamagero okumpa ebyetaago
Malayika yandabikira mu ngeri y’omuntu atuukiridde

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Obutaliiko musango bwange bwakakasibwa mutabani wange omuwere bwe yayogera
Abantu bange baazikirizibwa olw’ekibonerezo kya Katonda
Nakulembera eggwanga lyange okutuuka ku buwanguzi
outcome.answer: Obutaliiko musango bwange bwakakasibwa mutabani wange omuwere bwe yayogera

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
